_note: THE SAME FILE in confetti-butler, confetti-traffic and confetti-topo (copy by hand). Expected values were worked out by hand from syslog_core.py's rules, with documentation addresses (192.0.2.0/24). The two RFC 5424 cases are written to the RFC, not captured from a device. No PAN-OS line is included: none has been captured yet.

cases.name: cisco with sequence number, origin-id and timestamp
cases.raw: <189>123: SW1: *Sep  8 12:00:00.123 UTC: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet2, changed state to down

expect.message: Interface GigabitEthernet2, changed state to down

cases.name: plain rfc3164 with a host word
pri severity wins over the mnemonic digit
cases.raw: <187>Nov 18 10:15:02 R1 %BGP-5-ADJCHANGE: neighbor 192.0.2.2 Down Peer closed the session

expect.message: neighbor 192.0.2.2 Down Peer closed the session

cases.name: no pri: severity comes from the mnemonic
cases.raw: %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface Gi1, changed state to up

expect.message: Line protocol on Interface Gi1, changed state to up

cases.name: a word and colon is not a host
cisco sequence number 1: is not rfc5424
cases.raw: <189>1: R2: *Nov 18 10:00:00.000 UTC: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (192.0.2.9)

expect.message: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (192.0.2.9)

cases.name: rfc5424, not cisco: msgid becomes the mnemonic
cases.raw: <165>1 2026-11-18T10:00:00Z fw1 appname 1234 SYSTEM - link up on ethernet1/1

cases.name: rfc5424 with structured data and a cisco mnemonic in the text
cases.raw: <189>1 2026-11-18T10:00:00.123+01:00 R1 - - - [exampleSDID@32473 iut="3" eventSource="x"] %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface Gi1, changed state to down

expect.message: Interface Gi1, changed state to down
